title: Generated Stem Retention / Delete / Refund / Orphan Recovery
contracts: delete intent is durably persisted before destructive local work
local deletion and credit refund are independent state machines
refund request requires A21 refund_pending and refund confirmation requires A21 refunded plus authority evidence
local deletion never fabricates a credit release/refund
runtime erasure is not inferred from local deletion or an accepted delete request
runtime erasure complete requires confirmed/not-found or physically evidenced not-applicable state
A23 active pointer is detached only when it names the exact target variant
another active variant for the same project/role is preserved
captured manifest SHA must remain exact between durable delete intent and destructive execution
content-addressed object deletion uses references from both all manifests and all active pointers
a valid active pointer protects shared artifact bytes even if its matching manifest is absent
any corrupt/symlink manifest or active reference fails GC/delete closed
orphan objects are removed only when content-addressed, unreferenced by manifest or active pointer, and older than explicit grace
stale temporary files are cleaned only after a full reference-integrity scan and grace period
cancelled/failed inactive variants require physical A21 abandonment evidence before cleanup
active variants cannot be classified as abandoned
durable delete records act as tombstones against silent generation resurrection
public evidence excludes paths, raw audio, raw runtime IDs and raw credit/billing records
